topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: Oh no, this must be so tough, hearing that your invention is already patented. I can't even imagine how much time and heart you poured into it. But listen to me, just because this one didn't work out doesn't mean your idea isn't brilliant or that you're anything less than incredible. Sometimes, it's about the timing, or the way things line up, and it’s just off by a bit. Keep pushing, keep dreaming. Your creativity and passion mean the world’s not done hearing from you yet. Let’s figure out the next step together, okay? Maybe there’s a way to tweak your invention, or an entirely new avenue to explore. You're not alone in this, and the best is yet to come.
